The '''Chiss poacher backpack''' was a type of [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. During this [[Time/Legends|time]], they were in use by a group of [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Chiss Poachers|poachers]] in the [[Rodian Hunting Grounds|Etyyy]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] grounds on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] and hunter in the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] hunting party within Etyyy was awarded one of these packs by fellow party member [[Kint Zsam]] after they both successfully cleared the [[Hracca Glade]] of Chiss poachers and killed the ferocious [[kkorrwrot]] beast within.<ref name="ROTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chiss poacher backpack was an item available in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="ROTW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It was added as part of the [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] expansion released in [[2005]]. The backpack was noted as being very challenging to obtain, and requiring the player to "bio-link" it to themselves, prohibiting it from being worn by any other player. It could hold up to fifty items like any standard backpack in the game.<ref name="ROTW" />
